sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Armed Forces Acting in Aid of the Civil Power Amendment Ordinance 1998
sections.description:
Short title, application and commencement

ORDINANCE XIII OF 1998
PAKISTAN ARMED
FORCES (ACTING IN AID OF THE CIVIL POWER) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1998
ORDINANCE XIII OF
1998
An Ordinance to
amend the Pakistan Armed Forces
(Acting in Aid of
the Civil Power) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1998
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 26th November, 1998]
No.F.2(1)/98-Pub., dated
26-11-1998.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:-
1. Short title, application
and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Pakistan Armed
Forces (Acting in Aid of the Civil Power) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1998.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

ORDINANCE XIII OF 1998

1998
An Ordinance to
amend the Pakistan Armed Forces
(Acting in Aid of
the Civil Power) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1998
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 26th November, 1998]
No.F.2(1)/98-Pub., dated
26-11-1998.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:-
2. Substitution of section 5,
Ordinance XII of 1998.--In the Pakistan Armed Forces (Acting in Aid of the
Civil Power) Ordinance, 1998 (XII of 1998), for section 5, the following shall
be substituted, namely:--
"5. Investigation.--The
investigation of all the offences specified in the Schedule to this Ordinance
shall be conducted in accordance with the provisions of the Code of Criminal
Procedure, 1898 (Act V of 1898), and in appropriate cases the same may be
conducted by the Armed Forces."
